card.name: The z inside linezolid
card.fires_on: The letter 'z' in the middle of the drug name linezolid, after 'line'. It appears in MAOI interaction warnings, often after 'such as' or in lists of MAOI examples.

modes.label: Linezolid in MAOI lists
modes.description: The 'z' of linezolid in a list of MAOI examples after phenelzine and tranylcypromine.
modes.example: taking MAOIs or within 14 days of stopping such treatment. Examples: phenelzine, tranylcypromine, line<<z>>olid Mixed Agonist/Antagon

modes.label: Linezolid after 'MAOIs such as'
modes.description: The 'z' of linezolid in headings or sentences about using an SSRI with other MAOIs such as linezolid or methylene blue.
modes.example: 2.6 Use of Escitalopram Tablets with Other MAOIs such as Line<<z>>olid or Methylene Blue Do not start
